title: Hankweave Hank File
description: Schema for hank.json - the main workflow configuration file for Hankweave. See https://hankweave.dev/reference/configuration for documentation.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support

description.description: Optional description of what this hank does

model.description: Override model for this hank (e.g., 'sonnet' for Claude, 'flash' for Gemini, 'This task needs high reasoning')

dataHashTimeLimit.description: Override time limit for data hashing in milliseconds

enablePersistence.description: Enable filesystem persistence for sentinel outputs

healthCheckGracePeriodMs.description: Grace period for sentinel health checks (milliseconds)

waitForAllHealthChecks.description: Wait for all health checks before loading sentinels

name.description: Human-readable name displayed in UI and logs

promptFile.description: Path to a file containing the prompt (mutually exclusive with promptText)

promptText.description: Inline prompt text (mutually exclusive with promptFile)

appendSystemPromptFile.description: Path to a file containing system prompt to append (mutually exclusive with appendSystemPromptText)

appendSystemPromptText.description: Inline system prompt text to append (mutually exclusive with appendSystemPromptFile)

model.description: Model to use for this codon. Can be a Claude model ('sonnet', 'opus'), Gemini model ('gemini-2.0-flash-exp', 'flash'), or any other model supported by the configured shim.

continuationMode.description: How this codon should handle continuation from previous codons. 'fresh': Start a new session (default for most cases). 'continue-previous': Continue from the previous codon's session, maintaining context and conversation history. The previous codon must have completed successfully.

from.description: Source path (relative to config file or absolute)

to.description: Target path relative to projectPath (parent directory must exist). Always specifies the full target path including name. Examples: from: '../templates/foo', to: 'src/foo' → copies directory foo to src/foo; from: '../templates/foo', to: 'src/bar' → copies directory foo as src/bar; from: '../config.json', to: 'src/config.json' → copies file; from: '../config.json', to: 'src/settings.json' → copies file with rename

allowFailure.description: If true, failure of this operation won't fail the codon (default: false). Recommended for rig setup in loop codons where operations might fail in some iterations (e.g., copying files that don't exist yet).

If true, failure of this operation won't fail the codon (default: false). Recommended for rig setup in loop codons where operations might fail in some iterations (e.g., running commands that might not succeed initially).

rigSetup.description: Rig setup operations to run before codon starts. Each operation must complete successfully for codon to start.

description.description: Optional description shown to users about what this codon does

checkpointedFiles.description: Glob patterns for files to checkpoint during codon execution. These files will be: watched for changes and streamed to the client, tracked in the git-based checkpoint system, and resolved using gitignore rules for consistency.

env.description: Optional environment variables to set for the Claude process

copy.description: Glob patterns to copy from execution directory to output directory

beforeCopy.description: Optional commands to run before copying (run in executionPath)

outputFiles.description: Optional output copy steps to run after codon completion: files to copy out from a completed codon, with optional pre-copy commands.

maxConsecutiveFailures.description: Maximum consecutive failures before unloading sentinel. Default: 3

unloadOnFatalError.description: Whether to unload on fatal errors. Default: true

maxRetries.description: Number of retry attempts for failed LLM calls

model.description: The full model ID to use (e.g., "anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022", "openai/gpt-4-turbo").

joinString.description:
String to join entries in text-based log file. Only valid for text output. Supports escape sequences: 
 (newline), 	 (tab),  (carriage return), \ (backslash). Defaults to '
---
' for visual separation.

sentinels.description: Sentinels to run during this codon. Sentinels are parallel observation agents that process the event stream. Each entry is a wrapper object with sentinelConfig (portable sentinel configuration, file or inline) and settings (codon-specific settings like output paths and load requirements). This wrapper pattern keeps sentinel configs reusable across codons.
